name: Exire II
source:
A visual novel where you get to date this cute man, by the name of Liam.

Keep in mind that he's very shy and sensitive, and would appreciate if you try and be as nice to him as possible. He gets embaressed really easily.

Liam will appreciate you regardless of your gender. His whole purpose is to make you feel loved and special. 

[Edited from [url=https://intstories.itch.io/exire-ii]Itch.io[/url]]

A remake of the original Exire.
translation:
这是一部视觉小说，你可以和这个名叫利亚姆的可爱男人约会。

请记住，他非常害羞且敏感，如果你尝试尽可能善待他，他将不胜感激。他真的很容易感到尴尬。

无论你的性别如何，利亚姆都会欣赏你。他的全部目的就是让你感到被爱和特别。

[编辑自[url=https://intstories.itch.io/exire-ii]Itch.io[/url]]

原版《Exire》的重制版。
